no_adcom_quote.quote: This Application was not presented to the oncologic Drug Advisory Committee or any other external consultants.

summary: No advisory committee was convened for the AYVAKIT (avapritinib) NDA212608 application. The Multi-Discipline Review's Advisory Committee section (Section 9) explicitly states the application was not presented to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee or any other external consultants. As a result, there are no AdComm-driven linkages to the approval.
